retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, warm-toned portrait layout featuring a central figure in western attire with distressed, layered slab-serif typography and decorative filigree accents.
triggerTerms: warm outdoor portrait with rustic text

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a cowboy hat and denim shirt standing in a sun-drenched, soft-focus wooded area, with a right-aligned typographic block featuring weathered lettering and thin ornamental flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center to balance right-aligned text
Warm golden-hour lighting harmonizing with earth-toned clothing
Distressed text texture echoing the rugged outdoor setting
Thin horizontal lines and filigree framing the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, standing vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat serve as the primary anchor, followed by the large display text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the body, then shift right to the large display name and finally the smaller subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus trees and grass provide textured negative space that allows text to remain legible.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the background and hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo/navy of the denim shirt provides the main value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the text and highlights on the clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a focus on warm mid-tones and soft highlights.
paletteRestrictions: No pure blacks or whites; use tinted neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and clean sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses thick, blocky slab serifs with rounded corners
Secondary name uses a slightly cleaner, more condensed slab serif
Subtitle uses a wide-tracked, clean sans-serif
All display text features a weathered, stamped, or eroded texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' in primary name has a large, open counter
Serifs are slightly blunted to appear aged
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured slab serif paired with a clean, spaced-out sans-serif for modern-rustic contrast.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules above and below text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic slab serif structure for the primary name.
Good for the secondary, slightly more formal slab serif feel.
Clean sans-serif for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a cowboy hat and dark denim shirt standing in a sunlit, soft-focus autumn forest. The lighting should be warm and golden, with the man positioned on the left side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a right-aligned text block. The top word should be a large, lowercase, distressed slab serif. Below it, add a second word in uppercase slab serif, framed by thin horizontal lines and delicate scrollwork filigree. At the bottom right, add a subtitle in wide-tracked, clean uppercase sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the text properly distressed and weathered?
Is the filigree delicate and not overpowering?
Is the subject positioned to the left to allow for text on the right?
Is the color palette warm and earthy?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the weathered texture on the text
Specific shade of the denim shirt
mustRedesign: Any modern digital interfaces or icons

mustAchieve: Legible but heavily textured display type

postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serif 'a' has the correct open counter.
Ensure the horizontal lines do not touch the letters.
Verify the warm golden-hour lighting is consistent across the image.
Confirm the text tracking on the subtitle is sufficiently wide.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait of [Subject] in [Western Attire] + [Warm Forest Background] + [Right-Aligned Distressed Slab Serif Typography] + [Filigree Accents]
